6342563.name: Chabad of Bosques
6342563.note: Chabadpedia, his page: 'בשנת תש"ס יצא בשליחות הרבי למקסיקו, שם פועל בעיר מקסיקו סיטי. ובמשך השנים הביא מספר שלוחים שיעבדו תחתיו' (in 5760 he went out on the Rebbe's shlichus to Mexico, where he works in Mexico City, and over the years brought shluchim to work under him). Its Mexico page: 'בשנת תש"ס החלה לראשונה פעילות קבועה וממוסדת של חב"ד במדינה, עם הקמת בית חב"ד על ידי הרב יוסף יצחק מייזליש' (in 5760 Chabad's permanent activity in the country began, with the founding of a Chabad House by Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Mayzlesh; https://chabadpedia.co.il/index.php?title=%D7%9E%D7%A7%D7%A1%D7%99%D7%A7%D7%95). 5760 ran from Sept 1999 to Sept 2000. This is his listing today (Rabbi Yosef Y. and Tova Mayzlesh, with their son Rabbi Sholom Dov Ber); Chabadpedia does not say where in the city the first house was. Medium: one secondary source (two of its pages), the listing not named, and its 'first in the country' is not right (Chabad of Baja California, Tijuana, began in 1993). He was 'director of Chabad in Mexico' in 2018 (Pulse News Mexico) and 'el Rabino de la Jabad México' (Diario Judío, March 2018); Jabad Lubavitch México lit its Chanukah menorah at the Ángel de la Independencia in Dec 2013 (Diario Judío). Its chabad.org listing went up only on 2024-02-28 (Mexico City's, his son's, on 2023-12-26).

people.name: Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Mayzlesh
people.note: 'in 5760 he went out on the Rebbe's shlichus to Mexico' (Chabadpedia)

6260059.name: Chabad Lubavitch Mexico City
6260059.note: No start year found (Nov 2026 searches in English, Spanish and Hebrew; the family name is also spelled Meislish). By Aug 2018 it was running: Chabad-Lubavitch opened Mexico's first yeshiva on 26 Aug 2018 'under the direction of Rabbi Mendel Mayzlesh, son of Rabbi Yossef Mayzlesh, director of Chabad in Mexico' (Pulse News Mexico, 2 Sept 2018). Its site says only 'Founded in the mid-20th century' (chabadofmexico.com). Its chabad.org listing (Calderon de la Barca 339, Polanco) went up on 2023-12-26, after it was running, so the listing-year fallback is not used. Not in lubavitch.com's Mexico directory of Aug 2011 (Tijuana and Cancun only). His father's Chabad House in Mexico began in 5760 (1999-2000; Chabadpedia: see Chabad of Bosques, 6342563); this listing, his son Mendel's, has no year of its own (Chabadpedia: 'a shliach of the Rebbe in Mexico').

people.name: Rabbi Yossef Mayzlesh
people.note: 'director of Chabad in Mexico' (Pulse News Mexico, 2018)

118392.name: Chabad Lubavitch Guatemala
118392.note: Chabadpedia (Shalom Pelman's page): 'בשנת תש"ס יצא יחד עם אשתו יעל לפעול בשליחות הרבי בגואטמלה, וייסד את בית חב"ד בגואטמלה סיטי' (in 5760, Sept 1999 to Sept 2000, he and his wife Yael went on the Rebbe's shlichus to Guatemala and founded the Chabad House in Guatemala City), citing COLlive's 'Guatemala Marks 10 Years': a June 2010 celebration 'marked 10 years since Chabad-Lubavitch sent a Shluchim couple to the Central American country' (COLlive, 2 June 2010). Medium: both rest on the same report. lubavitch.com's directory, June 2012: '14 Calle 15-26 Zona 13'; today 9 Calle 14-64, Zona 13.

earlier.where: 14 Calle 15-26, Zona 13, Guatemala City (lubavitch.com's directory, June 2012)

117867.name: Chabad Lubavitch de Peru
117867.note: 'Following his marriage to Shterna Sara Slonim, the couple moved in 1987 to Lima, the nation's capital, where they established a Chabad House' (Chabad.org obituary of Rabbi Schneur Zalman Blumenfeld, 1 Nov 2021). Today Av. Salaverry 3075, San Isidro. Chabadpedia (his page): 'בט"ז מרחשון תשמ"ח יצא לשליחות הרבי ללימה פרו' (he left for Lima on 16 Cheshvan 5748, 8 Nov 1987); before that, in spring 1987, Merkos had offered him Mexico, Costa Rica or Switzerland, and the Rebbe circled Peru; in 5749 the Chabad House's first building was bought.

117811.name: Jabad Lubavitch de Chile
117811.note: Rabbi Menashe and Chaya Perman: 'In Chile since 1981, the Permans have experienced the country's last great earthquake of 1985' (lubavitch.com, 5 Mar 2010). lubavitch.com's directory, Jan 2010: 1575 Los Cactus, La Dehesa (as today). Chabadpedia (Menashe Perman's page): 'בשנת תשמ"ב, נשלח על ידי הרבי למדינת צ'ילה, וייסד את בית חב"ד בעיר הבירה סנטיאגו' (in 5742 he was sent to Chile and founded the Chabad House in Santiago): with 'since 1981', the autumn of 1981 (5742 began on 29 Sept 1981).

117866.name: Chabad of Paraguay
117866.note: 'Venezuelan-born Rabbi Yehoshua Forma, Chabad representative to the country since 1988'; its first project was the Gan Israel day camp; about 2001 Chabad bought a 1,200 sq meter plot for a permanent facility (lubavitch.com, 30 July 2003). Today Rabbi Levi Feigelstock (and Rabbi Mendel Pink) on its listing, Juan M. Frutos Pane 378. Chabadpedia (Levi Feigelstock's page): the Chabad House 'שהוקם באסונסיון על ידי הרב יהושע פורמה בשנת תשמ"ט' (founded in Asuncion by Rabbi Yehoshua Forma in 5749): with 'since 1988', the autumn of 1988 (5749 began on 12 Sept 1988). Rabbi Levi Feigelstock moved there in 5765 (2004-05) to run it; his son-in-law Rabbi Mendel Pink and his daughter Chana came in 5785.

people.name: Rabbi Levi Feigelstock
people.note: 'בשנת תשס"ה עבר עם משפחתו לפרגוואי כדי לנהל את פעילות בית חב"ד' (Chabadpedia): 5765, 2004-05

544944.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Cusco
544944.note: Chabadpedia (Ofer Kripor's page): 'ובחודש אדר תשס"ו יצאו בשליחות הרבי ופתחו בית חב"ד בקוסקו פרו', under Rabbi Schneur Zalman Blumenfeld (in Adar 5766, March 2006, they went on shlichus and opened the Chabad House in Cusco), citing ChabadInfo, 21 Adar 5766 (21 March 2006): 'לראשונה: בית חב"ד קבוע למטיילים בקוסקו' (for the first time, a permanent Chabad House for travelers in Cusco). Agreeing: 'new Chabad centers have opened in Cusco, Peru' (lubavitch.com, 5 Nov 2006; before that Merkos sent rabbinical students for the holidays) and 'has served Jewish travelers and locals in the region for the past 20 years' (COLlive, Feb 2026). lubavitch.com's directory, Jan 2010: 'calle granada 291, cusco'; today Calle Vitoque 631.

117879.name: Hogar Jabad Lubavitch
117879.note: 'Merkos L'inyonei Chinuch, the educational arm of the Lubavitch movement, has announced the opening of its new regional office in Caracas, Venezuela', the third in South America after Buenos Aires and Sao Paulo, headed by Rabbi Moshe Perman, 26, born in Israel, assisted by his wife Chaya, formerly of Toronto (JTA, 22 May 1975). lubavitch.com's directory, June 2012: Avenue J Washington, Qta Lore No. 8, San Bernardino (as today). Chabadpedia (Moshe Perman's page): 'ובשנת תשל"ה יצא בהוראת הרבי לשליחות הרבי לוונצואלה' (in 5735 he went on the Rebbe's shlichus to Venezuela); he first opened Camp Gan Israel Caracas, the country's first Jewish summer camp, and later the Or Chabad schools; in 5737 he founded Yeshivas Tomchei Tmimim Venezuela. His sons-in-law Rabbi Yehoshua Rosenblum and Rabbi Yosef Chaim Slavin are shluchim in Caracas.

503725.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Cancun
503725.note: Rabbi Mendel and Rachel Druk and their baby moved from Crown Heights to Cancun on Monday 2 July 2007 (Chabad.org, Fri 6 July 2007: 'the Druks' move last Monday'; the community's president picked them up at the airport), seeded by a Sami Rohr grant. Same in CrownHeights.info, 11 July 2007 ('have just moved to Cancun'), the NY Daily News, 24 July 2007 ('arrived in Cancun three weeks ago') and JTA, 18 July 2007. A 2012 Times of Israel profile's 'beginning of 2006' is wrong. lubavitch.com's directory, Aug 2011: 'Ave Antonio Enrikes Savenyak' (Av. Antonio Enriquez Savignac). In March 2012 it broke ground on a 15,000 sq ft center near the beach, dedicated to Dovid Malka (COLlive, 29 Mar 2012); its site now says it has relocated to Kukulkan Plaza, Km 13 of the hotel zone. Chabadpedia (Menachem Druk's page): 'בשנת תשס"ז יצאו בני הזוג לפעול בשליחות הרבי, וייסדו את בית חב"ד שבקנקון' (in 5767 they founded the Chabad House in Cancun).

earlier.where: Av. Antonio Enriquez Savignac, Cancun ('Ave Antonio Enrikes Savenyak' in lubavitch.com's directory, Aug 2011), before it moved to Kukulkan Plaza, Km 13

6523329.name: Chabad of Cozumel Mexico
6523329.note: Rabbi Dudi Caplin and Rabbi Shlomi Peleg. Chabadpedia (Caplin's page): after his year at 770 (5768) he served as a rabbinical student in Bolivia, then helped found Chabad in Kingston, Jamaica, 'ובהמשך בשנת תש"ע הקים יחד עם הרב שלומי פלג את בית חב"ד בקוזומל' (then in 5770 founded with Rabbi Shlomi Peleg the Chabad House in Cozumel). The same from ChabadInfo, 15 Jan 2024: 'opened by Rabbi Dudi Caplin in 5770, fourteen years ago, along with his friend, Rabbi Shlomi Peleg' (https://chabadinfo.com/magazine/how-the-mexican-coast-guard-was-removed-from-the-cozumel-chabad-house/). 5770 began on 19 Sept 2009, so the autumn of 2009, as 'Cozumel Supporters Mark 10 Years' (ChabadInfo, 2 Dec 2019), Peleg 'arrived four years ago' (Jewish Independent, 20 Sept 2013, https://jewishindependent.ca/oldsite/archives/sept13/archives13sept20-07.html; the idea came from the family behind Diamonds International) and the Caplins 'have led the Chabad House for 16 years' (CrownHeights.info, 19 Aug 2025, https://crownheights.info/chabad-news/918378/history-in-mexico-a-new-torah-scroll-in-cozumel/). Against: a Cozumel resident wrote that the community was not very active 'until January 2009, when Chabad opened its doors' (YeahThatsKosher, 29 Dec 2010, https://yeahthatskosher.com/?p=2379), and a GoKosher listing has 2008. The 2024 piece calls it the first Chabad House in Central America for Israeli tourists; it found a neglected government building at first and was pushed out of it by the Coast Guard about two years later. In Dec 2010 the Chabad House was on Calle 12 between Rafael Melgar and 5th Avenue; by Sept 2013 it had moved from its first small premises to 'a larger, 200-square-metre space upstairs in the central village courtyard'; today 5a Avenida Sur and Calle 1 Sur. Rabbi Caplin was recognized as Chief Rabbi of Quintana Roo in Nov 2025.

earlier.where: Calle 12, between Avenida Rafael Melgar and 5th Avenue, downtown Cozumel, six blocks from the ferry pier (as described in Dec 2010)

people.note: 'Rabbi David Caplin' in Dec 2010; 'opened by Rabbi Dudi Caplin' (ChabadInfo, 2024)

people.note: 'Rabbi Shalom Peleg' (Dec 2010), 'Rabbi Shlomo Peleg and his wife Noy' (Sept 2013)

5603886.name: Chabad Lubavitch Medellin
5603886.note: Its own site: 'נוסד על ידי הרב לוי ונונו והרבנית מימי ונונו בשנת 2016' (founded by Rabbi Levi Wanono and Rebbetzin Mimi Wanono in 2016; chabadofmedellin.com/about). A new mikvah in Aug 2021 'joined the many activities offered by Rabbi Levi and Mimi Wanono' (COLlive, 9 Aug 2021). Its chabad.org listing was made in July-Aug 2022. Today Carrera 41A #10-54, El Poblado. Chabadpedia (Mordechai Chaim Bigio's page): 'בשנת תשע"ו הגיע למדג'ין שבקולומביה, ופתח שם בית חב"ד' (in 5776, Sept 2015 to Sept 2016, he came to Medellin and opened a Chabad House), for about half a year before his marriage; he later founded Chabad of San Andres. Whether he came before the Wanonos is not said; both put its start in 5776 (2016 is mostly 5776).

people.name: Rabbi Mordechai Chaim Bigio
people.note: opened a Chabad House in Medellin in 5776, about half a year (Chabadpedia)
